description:
Hushfeed v0.73.0 has 134 patches for global TikTok 47.1.4 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

This one is mostly downloads and LIVEs. You can tick posts on a profile grid and save them in one run, or record a LIVE while you watch it. Feed filter got a minimum length and the tab bar can go see-through. A profile background you save won't vanish after a restart anymore. The release notes list every report this release changed something for.

Validation: 4491 runtime tests passed and 903 patch tests passed locally. Both Android lint checks passed. All 134 patches applied to the supported APK with resource and manifest checks. The attached release receipt identifies the exact source and bundle. Builds of this release were patched onto TikTok 47.1.4 and run on a Galaxy S22 and a Galaxy S25.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Refresh the Hushfeed source to update. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
